verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the official Stripe CLI doc, which says you can 'build, test, and manage your Stripe integration,' implying a testing workflow. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents a sandbox or test-mode environment kept separate from production data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/test mode isolated from live data, test API keys or test clocks for Billing scenarios, agent/MCP usage against sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
